text: All reference profiles shall support explicit typed variadic calls, receipt, and runtime forwarding. Packs shall reference a live invocation's additional descriptors; forwarding shall copy descriptors/complete values into a new packet. Type/index/count checks shall follow [0005](0005_functions_and_calls.md). Native C varargs shall require an adapter.
